system.description: As a reaction, to seeing an allied creature other than yourself, within 60 feet of you be forced to make a Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, by spending 1 ingot, you can form some of the metal on their person, into something that can pull them, dragging them up to 20-feet into a space closer to you, in a straight line without triggering opportunity attacks. If this movement would pull them out of the triggering effects range, they make their saving throw at advantage, otherwise, they gain a +2 bonus to their saving throw.
